children: Jupiter Mobile informed Jupiter Card users that the Avici project on Solana experienced a security incident earlier today. According to Foresight News, its card issuer partner Rain briefly paused card balance withdrawals as a precaution and completed a security check.

The check has now ended and services have returned to normal. Jupiter said no Jupiter accounts were affected, card payments remained available throughout, and on-chain wallets were not impacted. Users can now withdraw card balances as usual.

title: Jupiter Mobile Says Avici Security Incident Briefly Halted Card Withdrawals
